model._comment: Base model (last fallback before the session model, which sessionFallback disables). OpenRouter free router: picks any eligible free endpoint, so it spreads load instead of hammering one queue.

observerModel._comment: Observer primary: Nemotron 3 Super 120B free. Fastest verified free endpoint (138-202ms, 3/3 valid structured tool calls), 262k window.

observerFallbackModels._comment: Fallback 1: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning free. Newest 1M-window endpoint, 273-523ms, 5/6 tool calls (one plain-text miss).
Fallback 2: Qwen3.8 27B free. Most reliable of the new batch (9/9 tool calls), 288-830ms, 262k.
Fallback 3: Dots3 Note Preview free (661-840ms, 3/3 tool calls, 512k window).
Fallback 4: Apodex 1.1 Mini free. Newest free release (2026-10-01), 9/9 tool calls, 693-848ms typical but spiky (3.8s observed), 262k.
Fallback 5 (last resort): Ling 3.0 Flash Sante free. Replaces the retired ling-3.0-flash-fin endpoint; 765-783ms, 3/3 tool calls, 262k.

reflectorModel._comment: Reflector primary: Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B free. Strongest reasoning among verified free endpoints, 1M window (covers reflectorInputMaxTokens 80k for large pools), 337-358ms, 3/3 tool calls.

reflectorFallbackModels._comment: Fallback 1: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning free. Only other verified 1M-window free endpoint, 273-523ms, 5/6 tool calls.
Fallback 2: Dots3 Note Preview free (512k, 661-840ms, 3/3 tool calls).
Fallback 4: Apodex 1.1 Mini free (719-848ms typical, 9/9 tool calls, 262k).
Fallback 5 (last resort): Ling 3.0 Flash Sante free (replaces retired ling-3.0-flash-fin).

dropperModel._comment: Dropper primary: North Mini Code free (agentic coding judgement, 332-526ms, 3/3 tool calls, 256k). Thinking off - retention decisions are cheap.

dropperFallbackModels._comment: Fallback 1: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning free. Replaces nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b, which now returns an empty completion half the time (3/6 tool calls). 1M window, 273-523ms.
Fallback 3: Dots3 Note Preview free (512k, 661-840ms, 3/3 tool calls).
Fallback 4: Apodex 1.1 Mini free (719-848ms typical, 9/9 tool calls, 262k).
Fallback 5 (last resort): Ling 3.0 Flash Sante free (replaces retired ling-3.0-flash-fin).
